= DiabolicUI for Wotlk 3.3.5

Well met, traveler. I am but a humble tinkerer who took DiabolicUI, forked it for 3.3.5, and mended what small things I could along my travels through Northrend. Nothing grand, just a few fixes and features gathered on the road and shared freely, should they serve you as well as they have served me. The full list lies below.

image::docs/screenshots/main.webp[DiabolicUI in Winterspring]

== 🆕 New since 1.6.5

* 🪟 *Blizzard's windows in Diablo III's look*: stone in an iron frame, tabs as hanging banners, parchment, slate and leather behind each part. The spellbook is an open book, Immersion is Diablo III's conversation box, and the character window shows your resistances on a blood-red pentagram.
* 🏷️ *Nameplates* with casts and your auras (no need for Kui_Nameplates).
* ⏱️ *Cooldown times* on the action buttons (no need for OmniCC).
* 🎲 *Roll window* for master loot, off by default.
* 🎨 *GShade kit*: a darker Diablo look in one script (see below).

== 🚀 Getting Started

Drop the `DiabolicUI` folder in `Interface/AddOns/`. Everything is set in `/dui config`.

* `/dui move`: move the minimap, the chat, the menu buttons, the quest tracker (Blizzard's or Questie's) and TrinketMenu; right-drag the minimap to resize it. Also the *Unlock Frames* button in `/dui config`.

image::docs/screenshots/move-mode.webp[Unlock Frames: every movable frame highlighted]

=== 🎨 Optional: GShade

A darker Diablo look: colour grading, a blur on the distance, the UI left sharp.

. Close the game, then run `python3 extras/gshade/install.py` from the `DiabolicUI` folder (Windows: `py extras\gshade\install.py`).
. *Linux only*: set `d3d9` to *Native then Builtin* in winecfg, and run `winetricks d3dcompiler_47` in the game's prefix.
. Start the game. The first start is slow while the effects compile.

Presets, in-game checks and troubleshooting: link:extras/gshade/README.adoc[extras/gshade].

== ✨ Features

* ⚔️ *Action bars* between Diablo III health and mana orbs, one to three rows plus side bars, with the cooldown's time left on each button (no need for OmniCC).
* 💀 *Specialization button* on the skull: switches spec, and each spec can bring its gear set, Action Bar Saver profile, bar count and macros.
* 👼 *Stance button* on the angel: shows your current form and switches it.
* 🛡️ *Unit frames* for you, your target, focus, party and raid (grouped, with role icons); class colors and 3D portraits as options.
* 🏷️ *Nameplates* with the Diablo border, in the unit's reaction colour, with casts and your auras and their time left (no need for Kui_Nameplates).
* 💬 *Chat* that fades and slides in, with clickable web links, shorter system messages and Diablo chat bubbles.
* 🗡️ *Diablo III item tooltips* that follow your cursor.
* 📊 *GearScore* (GearScoreLite's count and colors) on gear, on players' tooltips, in the character window and under the inspect window's model.
* 🧭 *Minimap* with zone text, mail and Dungeon Finder buttons built in.
* 📜 *Quest tracker* that fades and moves; Blizzard's in Exocet, Questie's styled to match.
* 🪟 *Diablo III windows*: Blizzard's windows (character, spellbook, professions, guild, mail, merchant, achievements and more) in stone and iron, with banner tabs and red buttons. The character tab in two columns: your gear around a tall model, and the GearScore, your stats and the equipment manager beside it.
* 🎨 *Restyled Blizzard frames*: popups, Dungeon Finder, Escape menu, bags, loot window, world map, battleground scores.
* 💍 *TrinketMenu* restyled to match.
* 🎲 *Roll window* (optional, off by default): the master looter's rolls with their time left and Main Spec / Off Spec / Pass buttons, the boss's loot in a list, and a BiS line with BiS-Tooltip Renewed. Turn it on in `/dui config` → AddOns, and try it solo with *Fake Loot Roll* (Units page).

== Development

📖 *Developer documentation*: https://apt-get-update.github.io/DiabolicUI/[apt-get-update.github.io/DiabolicUI]: how the addon is built, the house rules and how to test, with diagrams. Its source is in `docs/`.

The Lua code is covered by an offline test suite (LuaUnit, plain Lua 5.1 with fake WoW APIs, no game client needed) - see `tests/README.md` for how it works.

[source,bash]
----
tests/run_all.sh                 # run every test
tests/coverage/run.sh            # run them with line coverage
tests/coverage/run.sh --readme   # ...and refresh the badge above
----
